# Fix race condition in tool registration (2025-06-21 22:34Z)

_**User**_

Fix this bug...

A race condition exists in the `register_computer_use_tools` function due to unsynchronized access to the `static mut TOOLS_INITIALIZED` variable. Multiple threads can simultaneously read this variable as `false` (indicating first-time initialization) before any thread sets it to `true` within the `Once::call_once` block. This allows multiple threads to proceed with the "first-time" tool registration logic, defeating the intended duplicate prevention and potentially leading to redundant tool registrations.
